headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson converted a tiebreaking four-point play with 1:25 left in the fourth quarter, Karl-Anthony Towns had 16 points and 16 rebounds and the New York Knicks beat Toronto 111-102 on Tuesday night, their 15th consecutive win over the Raptors.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Brunson converts tiebreaking 4-point play, scores 31 as Knicks win 15th straight over Raptors
